test_cases.title: Negative Login - Invalid Username
test_cases.description: Verify form rejection when authentication fails due to bad username.
test_cases.expected_result: The system rejects the attempt with a user‑visible error and does not proceed to a login state.
test_cases.actual_result:
**Execution Summary**

| Step | Action | Observation |
|------|--------|-------------|
| 1 | Navigated to `https://practicetestautomation.com/practice-test-login/` | Login form loaded; username and password fields visible |
| 2 | Typed `nonexistent_user` into the username field | Username field accepted the input |
| 3 | Typed `SecurePass123` into the password field | Password field accepted the input |
| 4 | Clicked the **Submit** button | POST request was attempted; the page remained on the login page |
| 5 | Verified the username error message | The error **“Your username is invalid!”** appeared below the username field. The form did **not** transition to a logged‑in state – the URL stayed `https://practicetestautomation.com/practice-test-login/`. |

**Result**

- The system rejected the login attempt with a user‑visible error message.
- No navigation to a “logged‑in” page occurred; the form stayed on the login page.
- All expected behaviors from the test case were observed.

**Conclusion: PASSED**

test_cases.title: Skip Link Accessibility
test_cases.description: Ensure assistive‑technology users can bypass navigation.
test_cases.expected_result: The skip‑link successfully transfers focus to the main content, meeting WCAG 2.4.7 compliance.
test_cases.actual_result:
All three steps have been executed and verified:

| Step | Action | Observed Result |
|------|--------|-----------------|
| 1 | Navigate to **https://practicetestautomation.com/practice-test-login/**** | Page loaded; the skip‑link “Press “Enter” to skip to content” is present at the top of the DOM. |
| 2 | Click the skip‑link **[href=\"#main-container\"]** | Focus moved to the `<section id="main-container">` element, bypassing the navigation block. |
| 3 | Click the `<h2>` heading “Test login” | Focus lands on the heading **“Test login”** (h2) / the first form field (input[name='Username']), confirming the navigation bypass. |

**Conclusion:** The skip‑link successfully transfers focus to the main content, satisfying WCAG 2.4.7 compliance.

**PASSED**
